lines.english: "Yo, Sugiura!"
"…Good morning, Ogiso."
"How was your weekend? Ah, you were at work, huh? Well, I ended up enjoying myself by eating cake and meat, though I had to be sober the whole time because I wasn't allowed to drink…"
"I'm impressed that you can still do something like that considering you have entrance exams in a week. You really must have nerves of steel, Ogiso."
"…? What is it?"
"You look a bit more cheerful compared to last week."
"…Because I was busy with work. I didn't even have time to take a breather."
"You feel better when you're busy? You really are the frugal type, aren't you, Sugiura?"
"…I guess so."
"I'm glad, though. We will be graduating soon. If only we could stay at this enjoyable pace for the remaining two weeks…"
"Ah, sorry, I have to go."
"Right, it's PE now?"
"Yes… I should go to the changing room."
"Sorry about that, I ended up giving you quite the tight window to change."
"…Changing, huh."
"…? Sugiura?"
"Heh… that sounds like fun."
"What's the matter all of a sudden?"
"Did you know, Ogiso? I love sports."
"That's… well, I do know that. I went to see your tournaments, after all."
"See you later… fufu…"
"If everyone thinks of me that way… then I'll show them. I'll show them that I'm the bitch everyone wants me to be."
"Thanks for the meal."
"I've received your cooking. Thanks for bringing it over. Also, I'm really sorry for not contacting you."
"Work has been hectic since Saturday, so I worked non-stop till late at night and went straight to bed the moment I got home. I couldn't even check my texts."
"That's why I didn't realize you left me a text until I received your food, Setsuna. I'm sorry if I ended up upsetting you or making you worry."
Even though I've done it so many times, no matter how much time has gone by, I still haven't gotten any better at lying…

It might have sounded persuasive if I had been working at the publishing company at the time, but if she were to ask what kind of unexpected problems could happen at a family restaurant given that it doesn't even operate at night, I wouldn't be able to answer her.
…It's a lie that I'm able to tell because Setsuna doesn't know about the details.
Choosing my words so carefully depending on who I'm talking to would have totally disgusted my past self…
"I just finished eating it. As you said, the texture and the seasoning was outstanding. It was delicious even when it's cold."
"Thanks for the cake too. And thanks for doing it every year."
"Lastly, since it's the actual day now, allow me to say this again. Happy birthday."
My only sincere words were also my last, so they managed to alleviate my conscience a little.
I'm sure Setsuna will be convinced with this text. Even if she had doubts, I don't think she'd go out of her way to verify them.
But in the end, no matter how much I cover it up, it won't disappear from my mind.
Nevertheless…
There's been no new text from Setsuna since the day before yesterday, as I thought.
Was her text not successfully delivered? Or did it disappear somewhere…?
But if it's not the case that her text wasn't successfully delivered, then where did it disappear to…?
There's only one possibility.
I was the first to fall asleep on Saturday night… while Koharu was still awake.
My cell phone was in my room. Anyone could've used it, given that I don't have a screen lock on it or anything.
"Koharu…"
If my guess is correct… then what were you trying to do?
I know that it's undoubtedly my fault you have become like this, and I won't let anyone else say otherwise…
But your lies are just going too far. You don't even tell me your true intentions anymore.
Your honesty, your sincerity…
Just where exactly has it gone?
"Oh? So you came, Takahiro. Why did you ditch PE?"
"I just don't have the time for it. My actual entrance exam is only five days from now, you know?"
"Then you didn't have to come to school… We're allowed to attend voluntarily now, after all."
"I'm still the class rep, for what it's worth. Besides, I'm curious about something."
"Curious about something, huh…"
"More importantly, I'm sorry to say that you'll have to spare me the silly banter. There was a party during the weekend and I didn't get to make any progress, so I'm in a real pickle right now."
"If someone as carefree as you thinks that, you must already be a lost cause…"
"Shut up."
"Well, this isn't what I'd call fun and silly banter, but there's been some new sensational news going on, and it ain't no laughing matter, at that."
"I told you that I'm in a bad situation, so don't tempt me…"
"During PE earlier… the girls made a big commotion again."
"…What happened?"
"You'll probably understand soon."
"What's wrong with her!? Showing that off!"
"What is she trying to do? I just don't get it at all."
"Is she trying to mock us?"
"Then, who exactly is she trying to mock?"
"Isn't she practically putting up a sign saying 'I am a slut' on her back?"
"I never would've thought that she was such a shameless person. How was she the class rep before?"
"She's just doing whatever she wants now…"
"And we're letting someone like her give the graduation speech? Seriously?"
"She's a disgrace to us third-years. Actually, she's a disgrace to the school! A total embarrassment! I wish she'd just disappear, seriously!"
"…What is the meaning of this?"
"Well you see… while they were undressing in the changing room, they saw her body was covered in kiss marks."
"…Huh?"
"Her back, her shoulder, her neck. There were even bite marks."
"No, hang on a second…"
"And she apparently didn't even try to hide them and just brazenly exposed her back while changing. …It made all the girls in the changing room freeze."
"…We're talking about Sugiura, right?"
"I wonder if she snapped because of the big rumor that's going around or if she's always been like that… but she's definitely poured fuel on the fire."
"Well, what about Sugiura? Where is she now?"
"She just went home…"
"…Only the first class is over, right?"
"We're allowed to attend voluntarily. No one will blame her for leaving early."
"That's…"
"However, why would she bother to come only for PE? …What, did she really come for no other reason than to show all that off?"
"But it seems that all that stuff about her stealing someone's man is the real deal. They say that there's a grain of truth in every rumor, but still…"
"Where are you going with this, Sugiura…"
